# vappcloud_vmm (Data Source)

Reads a VMM by opaque public ID, including system-managed default VMMs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vappcloud_vmm" "selected" {
  id = "vmm_example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `correlation_id` (String) Latest correlation ID.
- `cpu_cores` (Number)
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean)
- `desired_revision` (Number)
- `device_id` (String) Host device ID.
- `disk_mb` (Number)
- `health` (String) Agent-reported health.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `management` (String) Management owner.
- `memory_mb` (Number)
- `name` (String) VMM name.
- `observed_revision` (Number)
- `operation_id` (String) Latest operation ID.
- `operation_status` (String) Latest operation state.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version.
- `retain_disk` (Boolean)
- `state` (String) Runtime state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
